scope: Quantifier-free integer lattice proof at scale 10^18 over the conservative Phase 3 boxes e_i +/- r_i. Results are conditional on those boxes enclosing the Phase 2 eigenvalues; they do not re-prove the enclosure itself.

checks.script:
; Phase 4 / Gate 3: no sign flip inside the three certified eigenvalue boxes.
; Variables are eigenvalue numerators on the closed lattice e/10^18.
(set-logic QF_LIA)
(set-option :produce-models true)
(declare-const e0 Int)
(assert (and (<= 13325072930817286000 e0) (<= e0 16047208392451728000)))
(declare-const e1 Int)
(assert (and (<= 10409477555590692000 e1) (<= e1 13218241121140294000)))
(declare-const e2 Int)
(assert (and (<= 11068653927850545000 e2) (<= e2 13931346072149455000)))
(assert (or (<= e0 0) (<= e1 0) (<= e2 0)))
(check-sat)

; Phase 4 / Gate 3: every contraction numerator on the closed lattice
; [0, ceil(max_ratio*10^18)] stays strictly below 1/2.
(set-logic QF_LIA)
(set-option :produce-models true)
(declare-const c0 Int)
(assert (and (<= 0 c0) (<= c0 142236414018844185)))
(declare-const c1 Int)
(assert (and (<= 0 c1) (<= c1 183612969413261292)))
(declare-const c2 Int)
(assert (and (<= 0 c2) (<= c2 176678532445753015)))
(assert (or (>= (* 2 c0) 1000000000000000000) (>= (* 2 c1) 1000000000000000000) (>= (* 2 c2) 1000000000000000000)))
(check-sat)

; Phase 4 / Gate 3: SAT witness proving each closed lattice is nonempty
; and carries a strict contraction certificate.
(set-logic QF_LIA)
(set-option :produce-models true)
(declare-const e0 Int)
(assert (and (<= 13325072930817286000 e0) (<= e0 16047208392451728000)))
(assert (= e0 14686140661634507000))
(declare-const e1 Int)
(assert (and (<= 10409477555590692000 e1) (<= e1 13218241121140294000)))
(assert (= e1 11813859338365493000))
(declare-const e2 Int)
(assert (and (<= 11068653927850545000 e2) (<= e2 13931346072149455000)))
(assert (= e2 12500000000000000000))
(declare-const c0 Int)
(assert (= c0 142236414018844185))
(assert (< (* 2 c0) 1000000000000000000))
(declare-const c1 Int)
(assert (= c1 183612969413261292))
(assert (< (* 2 c1) 1000000000000000000))
(declare-const c2 Int)
(assert (= c2 176678532445753015))
(assert (< (* 2 c2) 1000000000000000000))
(check-sat)
(get-model)

; Gate 5 Rational Leakage Refutation SMT-LIB2 Bounded Model
; QF_NRA check that an extracted rational cannot simultaneously stay strictly
; inside the half-unit contraction bound and leak at or beyond it.
;
; Safety property (exact extraction):     den > 0  and  2*|num| <  den
; Leakage assumption (its negation):      den > 0  and  2*|num| >= den
; The conjunction is unsatisfiable, so no rational surviving the extraction
; bound can leak past it.
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-const num Real)
(declare-const den Real)
(assert (> den 0.0))
(assert (< (* 2.0 (abs num)) den))
(assert (>= (* 2.0 (abs num)) den))
(check-sat)

; Twistor Googly Refutation SMT-LIB2 Bounded Model
; QF_NRA check for helicity bound breakdown under sign-mixed conditions.
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-const s Real)
(declare-const d Real)
(assert (>= s 0.0))
(assert (>= d 0.0))
(assert (not (< (* 2.0 s (+ d 1.0)) (* 3.0 (+ s 1.0) (+ d 2.0)))))
(check-sat)

; Yang-Mills Lattice Refutation Script (Phase 33)
; Math 3.0 - Bounded Boundary Sweep & Sign-Mixed Inversion Tribunal
; Proves that boundary sign inversion in discrete gauge field plaquette determinants
; leads to an inconsistent state (UNSAT witness).

(set-logic QF_NRA)
(set-option :produce-models true)

(declare-fun S () Real)
(declare-fun T () Real)
(declare-fun D () Real)

(assert (>= S 0.0))
(assert (>= T 0.0))
(assert (>= D 0.0))

; Cauchy-Schwarz constraint for Sylvester diagonal: S <= T always holds for positive invariants
(assert (<= S T))

; Assume DSITNI stability holds: 2 * S * (D + 1) < 3 * (T + 1) * (D + 2)
(assert (< (* (* 2.0 S) (+ D 1.0)) (* 3.0 (* (+ T 1.0) (+ D 2.0)))))

; Contradictory assertion: assume DSITNI is violated (negation of stability)
(assert (>= (* (* 2.0 S) (+ D 1.0)) (* 3.0 (* (+ T 1.0) (+ D 2.0)))))

(check-sat)
(get-model)

; SMT-LIB2 witness: finite-capacity actual-infinity obstruction.
; Logic: QF_LIA
;
; Concrete four-step instance of `actual_infinity_violates_conservation`
; (lean/spec_v4/ActualInfinityRefutation.lean).  A traversal starts at state 0
; and strictly increases by at least one unit per step.  With lattice capacity
; 3, the fourth state must be at least 4, so the traversal cannot remain inside
; the lattice.  The general parametric theorem is proved in Lean; this script
; is an executable finite instance, not a proof of the general theorem.

(set-logic QF_LIA)

(declare-const capacity Int)
(declare-const s0 Int)
(declare-const s1 Int)
(declare-const s2 Int)
(declare-const s3 Int)
(declare-const s4 Int)

; The finite lattice has capacity 3 and the traversal starts at state 0.
(assert (= capacity 3))
(assert (= s0 0))

; Each step must strictly increase the state index by at least one unit.
(assert (>= s1 (+ s0 1)))
(assert (>= s2 (+ s1 1)))
(assert (>= s3 (+ s2 1)))
(assert (>= s4 (+ s3 1)))

; Claim: every visited state stays inside the finite capacity.
(assert (<= s4 capacity))

(check-sat)
(exit)

; SMT-LIB2 Verification Script: Continuity Refutation in a Finite Lattice
; Logic: QF_LIA
;
; A continuous path that remains inside a finite lattice of size N can move at
; most one lattice unit per discrete step. It therefore cannot traverse N+1
; distinct states in at most N steps. The constraints below encode that
; discrete intermediate-value obstruction and are jointly unsatisfiable.

(set-logic QF_LIA)

(declare-const lattice_size Int)
(declare-const path_steps Int)
(declare-const path_span Int)

; A nonempty finite lattice.
(assert (> lattice_size 0))

; The discrete path is contained in the lattice: at most N unit transitions.
(assert (>= path_steps 0))
(assert (<= path_steps lattice_size))

; A continuous traversal that leaves the initial state must span at least N+1
; distinct lattice positions.
(assert (>= path_span (+ lattice_size 1)))

; Each unit step can increase the span by at most one lattice unit.
(assert (<= path_span path_steps))

(check-sat)
(exit)
